{{Top|leg}}
The '''Great Election Day Debate''' was the day that [[Jagged Fel]], [[Natasi Daala]] and [[Vitor Reige]], all active candidates for the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial]] [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] election, debated against each other shortly before the actual polling began. The event occurred sometime in [[44 ABY]] and was seen by all citizens of the Imperial Remnant as a requirement.<ref name="apocalypse">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse]]''</ref>

During the debate, Fel announced that he was withdrawing from the race and endorsing Reige which allowed the admiral to defeat Daala.<ref name="apocalypse" />
